payout_quote: Our Refer a Friend program allows eligible clients to earn USD 200 for each friend they refer to IBKR. You will receive USD 200 for each referred friend who: opens an individual or joint account using your unique referral link; deposits at least USD 10,000 (or equivalent) within 30 days; maintains a balance of at least USD 10,000 (or equivalent) for 1 year.
steps: Be an IBKR client with an individual or joint account, an account net liquidation value of at least USD 2,000, and at least one securities trade placed.
Share your unique IBKR referral link with friends.
Your friend opens an individual or joint IBKR account using your referral link.
Your friend deposits at least USD 10,000 within 30 days of opening.
Your friend maintains a balance of at least USD 10,000 for 1 year.
You receive USD 200 for each qualifying referred friend (referrers limited to 15 referrals per year and 30 total).
catches: Very high bar on the friend's side: $10,000+ deposit within 30 days AND maintained for a full year - most referrals will not qualify.
Cap: 15 referrals per year and 30 referrals total ($6,000 lifetime max).
You must already be an IBKR client with $2,000+ account value and at least one securities trade placed.
No payout when the referrer and the new client are family members or others living at the same exact physical address.
Tax-deferred accounts are ineligible; certain countries are ineligible; financial advisors/hedge funds/institutional accounts ineligible.
You must have no involvement with the referred account after the referral (no training them, no trading their account, no collecting applications).
The $200 arrives only after the friend's 1-year maintenance period.
biggest_catch: Your friend must deposit $10,000+ and keep it there for a full year before you see the $200 - an extremely high bar, plus a 15/year and 30-lifetime cap.
eligibility: IBKR clients with individual or joint accounts, account net liquidation value of at least USD 2,000, and at least one securities trade placed; friends must not share your exact physical address.
timing: Paid after the referred friend completes the 1-year $10,000 balance maintenance period.
